text:
alice: Anyone else seeing mini-gang jobs repeatedly evicted in eu-west1-b this morning?
bob: Yep, tiny 4-GPU pods keep bouncing -> scheduled onto thin-2 nodes then preempted by larger jobs.
alice: paste from scheduler events: 
```
PreemptEvent: pod=mini-gang-42 node=eu-west1-b-thin-2 reason=taint.score>0.8
scheduler_debug: chosenNode=eu-west1-b-thin-2 score=12, preemptible=true reschedule_delay=6s
```
chandra: I think network jitter (conntrack spikes) is causing nodes to get a transient taint like `egress-flare=true`. scheduler treats that as high-risk and preempts to other nodes, then they come back and we replay -> thrash.
emma: cost hit: small-workloads team reports ~12% extra GPU-hours week-over-week for tiny-job namespace.
bob: symptoms: concentrated in racks with 2-slot hosts ("thin shelves"). When a big gang lands it squeezes tiny pods out.
alice: quick mitigation ideas: 1) avoid scheduling tiny-gangs onto thin-shelf nodes via soft anti-affinity, 2) increase taint_tolerance window so we don't preempt immediately on a brief egress flare, 3) prefer compact placement when tiny-gangs arrive.
chandra: +1. Also propose scheduler knob `delay_preempt_on_recovery: 30s` so we don't immediately evict on a transient taint.
devops-bot: autoscaler event: +2 nodes eu-west1-b at 2026-03-21T07:12Z (scale_id: b3c9a)
emma: telemetry additions: add `eviction.tiny_gang_whip.count` and `scheduler.requeue_delay_seconds` histogram. we'll need those on GPU infra dashboard.
bob: config sketch: 
```
apiVersion: scheduler.redwood/v1
kind: PlacementPolicy
metadata:
  name: tiny-gang-protections
spec:
  avoidThinShelf: true  # soft preference, weight=15
  taintToleranceSeconds: 45
  delayPreemptOnRecoverySeconds: 30
  compactPlacementFor: tiny-gang
```
chandra: testing plan: spin staging racks with toxiproxy-induced conntrack jitter, run 4h soak, then compare `eviction.tiny_gang_whip` and `gpu.effective_runtime`.
emma: rollout: canary scheduler patch to 3% in eu-west1-b, monitor whiplash.rate, reschedule_delay_p95, and cost.delta. rollback if evictions > baseline +10%.
alice: ops action owners: @chandra run staging jitter tests, @emma add metrics+dashboard tiles, @bob produce cost delta report, @alice open scheduler PR and coordinate canary. devops-bot: will publish structured scale events and taint notices to #eng-platform.
devops-bot: noted and will attach autoscaler + taint events to thread.
bob: grep helper: `kubectl -n kube-system logs -l app=scheduler -c scheduler | jq -r .msg | grep -E "PreemptEvent|reschedule_delay"`
chandra: good. I'll start the staging replay now and tag results here.
alice: thanks everyone  if canary looks stable after 24h we'll promote and tune warm-pool sizing for tiny-workloads. :thumbsup:
